Name: Projection Parameters
Description: The Projection Parameters (PRJPSB) TRE contains the projection parameters of the absolute coordinate system when it's a cartographic (grid) coordinate system. This extension shall be present when the coordinate units (GEOPS.UNI Field) are meters (M).

PRN.Name: Projection Name
PRN.Description: This field shall contain the name of the projection to which the Image Segment refers. The default value is "Transverse Mercator". The values for this field are found in Table P-20 (originally from DIGEST Part 3-6, Edition 2.1, Table 6-5).

PCO.Name: Projection Code
PCO.Description: This field shall contain the code of the projection to which the Image Segment refers. The default is "TC". The values for this field are found in Table P-20 (originally from DIGEST Part 3-6, Edition 2.1, Table 6-5).

NUM_PRJ.Name: Number of Projection Parameters
NUM_PRJ.Description: This field shall contain the number of projection parameters. The PRJn field should be repeated as necessary depending on the projection code (see Table P-20; originallly from DIGEST Ed. 2.1 Part 3-6). If the number of projection parameters provided is lower than specified in Table P-20 (originally from Part 3-6 of DIGEST), then the missing parameter values are 0.

PRJ<NUM_PRJ>.Name: nth Projection Parameter
PRJ<NUM_PRJ>.Description: This field contains the nth projection parameter. Each occurrence of this field provides an approximate parameter to accurately describe the projection. See Table P-20 (originally from Part 3-6 of DIGEST Ed. 2.1) to know the kind of parameters needed for each projection code and the values allowed for this field.

XOR.Name: Projection False X (Easting) Origin
XOR.Description: This field shall contain the projection false X (easting) origin. The default value, 000000000000000, implies that there is no projection false X origin.

YOR.Name: Projection False Y (Northing) Origin
YOR.Description: This field shall contain the projection false Y (northing) origin. The default value, 000000000000000, implies that there is no projection false Y origin.
